Concrete and New Technologies in Concrete Testing
description: Review concrete properties, site quality checks and developing methods used to assess concrete performance.
learningOutcomes: Recognise key properties of fresh and hardened concrete and common acceptance checks
Compare established sampling and testing with selected non-destructive and digital methods
Identify when test results, site records or unexpected findings require escalation
audience: Resident engineers, resident technical officers and construction supervisors involved in concrete works.

title: Confined Space Awareness
description: Recognise confined-space hazards and the controls that support safe planning, entry and supervision.
learningOutcomes: Identify confined spaces and common atmospheric, access and work activity hazards
Explain the purpose of risk assessment, entry permits, monitoring and communication
Recognise emergency arrangements and situations that require work to stop
audience: REs, RTOs and site supervisors who may coordinate or oversee work near confined spaces.

title: Design Safety of Formwork Structures and Supervision
description: Explore temporary works design responsibilities and the site checks needed before, during and after formwork use.
learningOutcomes: Recognise loads, stability risks and the role of an approved formwork design
Review erection, inspection, alteration and concreting hold points
Document departures from design and escalate concerns to the responsible professional
audience: REs, RTOs and supervisors involved in formwork and concrete construction.

title: Geopolymer and Self-Compacting Concrete: Basic Concepts
description: Understand how alternative binders and self-compacting mixes affect production, placement and quality verification.
learningOutcomes: Describe basic materials and performance considerations for geopolymer concrete
Explain flowability, segregation resistance and placement considerations for self-compacting concrete
Identify trial mix, testing and site documentation questions for project teams
audience: REs, RTOs and construction personnel reviewing non-conventional concrete specifications.

title: Critical Supervision of Precast, PPVC and Post-Tensioning Works
description: Focus on inspection and coordination points for prefabricated components, volumetric modules and post-tensioned elements.
learningOutcomes: Identify fabrication, lifting, installation and connection checks for precast and PPVC works
Recognise tendon, anchorage, stressing and grouting supervision points
Record non-conformances and coordinate hold points with designers and specialist contractors
audience: REs, RTOs and supervisors involved in precast, PPVC or post-tensioning works.

title: Safe Welding Techniques
description: Review welding hazards, preparation and controls for safer hot work on construction sites.
learningOutcomes: Recognise fire, fume, electrical and eye hazards associated with welding
Review hot-work permits, isolation, ventilation, fire watch and protective equipment
Identify inspection and reporting steps for unsafe conditions or defective welds
audience: Site supervisors and RE/RTO personnel overseeing welding or steelwork activities.

title: Safety in Formwork Erection
description: Examine safe sequences and supervision practices for erecting, altering and dismantling formwork.
learningOutcomes: Identify instability, falling-object and work-at-height risks during formwork erection
Review safe work procedures, temporary bracing, lifting and access arrangements
Recognise inspection and handover checks before loading or concreting
audience: REs, RTOs, formwork supervisors and construction site teams.

title: Electric Vehicle Safe Use and Fire Hazard Prevention Workshop
description: Introduce electric-vehicle and charging-system hazards relevant to workplaces and construction facilities.
learningOutcomes: Recognise charging, damaged-battery and electrical hazards
Discuss site arrangements for inspection, isolation and emergency communication
Identify escalation steps and the limits of a non-specialist response to an EV incident
audience: REs, RTOs, facility teams and supervisors responsible for work areas with EVs or chargers.

title: WSH Design for Safety Regulations
description: Understand how design-stage risk reviews and information sharing support safer construction and maintenance.
learningOutcomes: Describe the purpose and participants of Design for Safety reviews
Recognise design risks that should be eliminated or reduced before work starts
Understand how residual risks and precautions are recorded and communicated
audience: REs, RTOs, designers, project managers and construction supervisors.

title: Safety in Demolition Works
description: Review demolition planning, structural stability and site controls for work near existing structures.
learningOutcomes: Identify survey, sequencing and temporary support questions before demolition
Recognise risks from falling debris, utilities, adjacent structures and plant movement
Review supervision, exclusion-zone and emergency arrangements
audience: REs, RTOs and supervisors involved in demolition or alteration works.

title: Supervision Challenges in Foundation Works
description: Explore construction and inspection challenges in piling, excavation and other foundation activities.
learningOutcomes: Recognise ground-condition, excavation, piling and groundwater risks
Identify key inspection records, test results and deviations that need review
Coordinate reporting and escalation when site conditions differ from design assumptions
audience: REs, RTOs and construction supervisors involved in foundation works.
